en: a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water
cn: 油, 石油, 油画颜料

en: a machine for performing calculations automatically
cn: 电脑, 电子计算机

en: the practical application of science to commerce or industry

en: a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
cn: 机会, 时机

en: a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
cn: 动物

en: a database containing an ordered array of items (names or topics)

en: earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something

en: a large room for gatherings or entertainment
cn: 门厅, 走廊, 会堂

en: a form of trustworthiness; the trait of being answerable to someone for something or being responsible for one's conduct
cn: 责任, 职责, 负担, 可靠性

en: suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc

en: having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
cn: 成功的, 一帆风顺的, 顺利的

en: equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)

en: someone who is considered for something (for an office or prize or honor etc.)

en: being of use or service

en: a room equipped for preparing meals

en: required activity

en: the visible part of a television transmission

cn: 自由, 坦率, 特权

en: a depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value
cn: 博物馆

en: the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees
cn: 木材, 木制品

en: an assortment of things from which a choice can be made

en: a diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it)

en: a room used primarily for sleeping
cn: 卧室

en: a white crystalline carbohydrate used as a sweetener and preservative

en: sit or lie with one's limbs spread out
cn: 伸开手足躺, 爬行, 蔓生, 蔓延

examples.text: He sprawled out on the sofa next to me.
She found her sister sprawled unconscious on the sidewalk.
All my homework is sprawled on my desk.

en: a twisted and tangled mass that is highly interwoven
cn: 缠结, 纠结的一团, 困惑, 纠纷, 混乱

examples.text: My head has become a tangle of confusion.

I can't get the tangles out of my hair.

en: make more compact by or as if by pressing
cn: 压缩, 压紧

en: the rear part of a ship
cn: 尾部, 船尾, 臀

She hinted that he was of a stern and unforgiving character, more ready to resent than to pardon injuries.

en: feel grief
cn: 使悲伤

examples.text: Paralysed and yet walking, blind and yet standing, deaf and yet hearing, that is a person who is grieving.

en: a slide of large masses of snow and ice and mud down a mountain
cn: 雪崩, 山崩, 大量

examples.text: The avalanche brought tonnes of snow down to the foot of the mountain.

An avalanche is a mass of snow, ice and rocks that rapidly slides off a mountain slope.

en: a sharp strain on muscles or ligaments
cn: 扳钳, 扳手, 扭伤, 歪曲, 痛苦

examples.text: The astronaut lost his grip on the wrench and all he could do was watch in dismay as it floated serenely away.

en: a glass filled to the brim (especially as a toast)
cn: 缓冲器, 满杯

examples.text: As she was pulling out of the parking space, she hit the bumper of the car in front of her.

We will need to replace the front bumper.

en: make understand
cn: 教育, 启发, 启蒙, 开导, 教导

examples.text: I'm sure you'll soon be able to enlighten us all as to the real state of affairs.
The ray of wisdom must enlighten new horizons.
I am going to give you a beautiful and enlightening example of what I read.

en: (architecture) a slender upright spire at the top of a buttress of tower
cn: 小尖塔, 尖峰, 高峰, 极点

en: make a concoction (of) by mixing
cn: 调合, 捏造, 编造

examples.text: The herbalist will concoct a potion for that.

I not only concocted the plan, but I also carried it out.

en: an imaginary line around the Earth forming the great circle that is equidistant from the north and south poles
cn: 赤道

examples.text: The equator divides the earth into two hemispheres.

The horse latitudes are located at about 30 degrees north and south of the equator.

en: force to drink
cn: 使湿透, 使充满

examples.text: I was caught in a shower and got drenched to the skin.

If it had not been for your raincoat, I would have been drenched to the skin.

en: inclined to or conducive to companionship with others
cn: 好交际的, 社交的, 过社会生活的

examples.text: Some of the most sociable people I know have friends both online and off-.

I attended the party just to be sociable.

en: an optical illusion in which atmospheric refraction by a layer of hot air distorts or inverts reflections of distant objects
cn: 海市蜃楼, 幻景, 妄想

examples.text: After five hours on the hot sand, he began to see something on the horizon that looked like a desert mirage.

A mirage is said to be an illusion.

en: a quality that arouses emotions (especially pity or sorrow)
cn: 伤感力, 感伤, 悲怅, 同情, 偶然因素, 哀婉动人的词句

examples.text: When I was younger, I liked a lot of pathos in music.
I was intrigued by the pathos in your work.
It feels like they went off like that for pathos.

en: a person who participates in or is skilled at some game
cn: 竞赛者, 上场队员, 游戏者, 演员

examples.text: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.

During the middle game, each player tries to weaken the opponent, attacking their pawns and capturing their pieces.

en: a principle or condition that customarily governs behavior
cn: 规则, 统治, 控制, 支配, 规律, 标准, 章程, 破折号, 铅线

examples.text: He makes it a rule to take a walk every morning.

As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.

en: a licensed medical practitioner
cn: 医生, 博士

He is going to be a doctor when he grows up.

en: concerning or affecting a particular person or his or her private life and personality
cn: 私人的, 涉及隐私的, 有人性的, 人称的, 亲自的, 身体的

The three fundamental factors for happiness are: financial security, a sense of purpose in one's life, and good personal relationships.

en: having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
cn: 简单的, 普通的, 朴素的, 单纯的, 绝对的, 初级的, 原始的, 迟钝的

examples.text: The job looked quite simple, but it took me a week.
What we had to do was really quite simple.
What is true is too simple, it can only be achieved by way of the complex.

en: the event of something burning (often destructive)
cn: 火, 炉火, 电炉, 火灾, 闪光体, 炮火, 热情

examples.text: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.

My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.

en: present reasons and arguments
cn: 提出理由, 争论, 辩论

examples.text: Why don't we stop arguing over these piddling matters and get to the issues at hand?
After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.
Give me the liberty to know, to utter, and to argue freely according to conscience, above all liberties.

en: a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect
cn: 颜色, 面色, 颜料, 外貌

examples.text: We have your size, but not in that color.

This material seems to change color when the light strikes it.

en: concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities
cn: 严肃的, 认真的, 重要的, 严重的

He could not come because of his serious illness.

en: established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules
cn: 法律的, 法定的, 合法的

en: either of the two categories (male or female) into which most organisms are divided
cn: 性别, 性欲

en: a large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property
cn: 公园, 停车处

This week the cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.

en: one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes
cn: 卡片, 纸牌, 节目单, 明信片, 梳棉机

examples.text: I'd like to pay with a credit card.

en: an interpretation of a matter from a particular viewpoint
cn: 一种描述, 版本, 译文

en: a natural protective body covering and site of the sense of touch
cn: 皮肤, 皮

en: a daily or weekly publication on folded sheets; contains news and articles and advertisements
cn: 报纸

en: reason
cn: 场合, 时机, 机会, 诱因, 理由

en: merchandise issued for sale or public showing (especially a record or film)
cn: 释放, 发泄, 豁免, 发行, 释放证书

en: a group's refusal to work in protest against low pay or bad work conditions
cn: 罢工, 打击, 殴打

en: equality between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account
cn: 平衡, 差额

en: temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
cn: 露营, 帐篷

en: directs the work of others
cn: 主人, 硕士, 大师, 母机

en: a soft yellow malleable ductile (trivalent and univalent) metallic element; occurs mainly as nuggets in rocks and alluvial deposits; does not react with most chemicals but is attacked by chlorine and aqua regia
cn: 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵

examples.text: This stuff is worth its weight in gold!
The light of autumn afternoons colours the landscape in hues of yellow, orange, red, gold and brown.

en: a conveyance that transports people or objects
cn: 交通工具, 车辆, 传播媒介

en: not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
cn: 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的

cn: 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的

cn: 一餐, 膳食, 粗粉

en: a change for the better; progress in development
cn: 进步, 改善, 利用

examples.text: It's only an incremental improvement over what we had before, but at least it demonstrates some progress.

en: a set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones)
cn: 代码, 密码, 法规, 法典

en: have its essential character; be comprised or contained in; be embodied in
cn: 组成, 存在于, 一致

cn: 探险, 探测, 探究

en: a general inclusive concept

en: the total amount and type of insurance carried
